en: Never loses a target on the field

ko: 전장 사선을 먼저 읽고 비켜 선다
en: Reads the line of fire first and steps aside
Strikes first once an engage begins
The controls stay steady even in a brawl
Firepower climbs more steeply with growth
Keeps the mech standing longer as it grows

ko: 전장에서 쫓고 피하는 감각이 함께 산다
en: Both chasing and evading sharpen on the field
Feels right at home in an engage
Looks ready to fall, yet holds on to the end
Once fired up, the firepower comes in waves
Moves in a way that is hard to hit anywhere
Leans neither to offense nor defense

ko: 주력 메크에 타면 기체와 한 몸이 된다
en: Becomes one with the mech when riding a main mech

ko: 제 역할군 메크에서 실력이 온전히 나온다
en: Shows full skill in a mech of their own role
Never crumbles when riding a tank mech
Goes for the weak spot when riding an assassin mech

ko: 원딜 메크에 타면 한 발도 허투루 쏘지 않는다
en: Never wastes a shot when riding a marksman mech

ko: 능숙 이상으로 다루는 메크에서 한층 날카로워진다
en: Grows sharper in mechs handled at Skilled or above
